title:
A paint party,
delivered to your door.
subtitle: We're a small mobile studio based on the Bellarine. We pack up everything you need and turn your living room, backyard or function space into the studio for the night.

steps.title: Pick a painting
steps.body: Choose from our catalogue of crowd-favourites, or tell us your theme and we'll design something custom - Taylor Swift era? French Riviera? Black cat under the moon? Done.

steps.title: We bring it all
steps.body: Canvases, easels, paints, brushes, aprons, tablecloths - the whole studio packs into the van and unpacks at your place. You do not have to lift a paintbrush ahead of time.

steps.title: BYO & sip
steps.body: Bring whatever you're drinking - bubbles, longnecks, lemon-lime & bitters, all welcome. We guide you through, stroke by stroke, for 2-3 messy, brilliant hours.

perks: Operating across Geelong, Surf Coast & the Bellarine. Other locations by request.
Mobile setup - we come to you, or your venue (with their permission)
Small groups welcome - book the whole room or just a few mates
Custom catalogue - pick from our designs or commission a one-off
Tables & chairs available at extra cost by prior arrangement
